problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet of 8 distinct vehicle types to transport 8 different categories of cargo along a fixed network of 8 sequential route segments. The revenue generated per ton of cargo for each vehicle type is as follows:
* For Vehicle Type Alpha, revenue is 17.539 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Beta, revenue is 9.35 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Gamma, revenue is 9.936 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Delta, revenue is 15.81 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Epsilon, revenue is 14.964 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Zeta, revenue is 15.718 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Eta, revenue is 18.159 per ton
* For Vehicle Type Theta, revenue is 6.33 per ton

The transit time required per ton for each vehicle type on each route segment is detailed below:
*For Vehicle Type Alpha, Segment 1 consumes 0.424 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 1.093 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 1.303 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 1.377 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 0.614 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 0.445 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 1.859 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 0.632 (ton-hours)
*For Vehicle Type Beta, Segment 1 consumes 0.232 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 0.709 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 1.131 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 1.34 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 1.531 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 0.462 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 1.114 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 0.776 (ton-hours)
*For Vehicle Type Gamma, Segment 1 consumes 1.504 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 0.847 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 1.66 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 0.545 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 1.99 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 1.139 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 0.963 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 1.506 (ton-hours)
*For Vehicle Type Delta, Segment 1 consumes 0.882 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 0.264 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 0.994 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 0.718 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 1.39 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 1.148 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 1.694 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 1.081 (ton-hours)
*For Vehicle Type Epsilon, Segment 1 consumes 0.48 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 0.467 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 1.231 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 0.677 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 0.581 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 1.895 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 0.451 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 1.849 (ton-hours)
*For Vehicle Type Zeta, Segment 1 consumes 1.165 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 1.886 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 1.71 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 0.738 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 1.046 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 0.354 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 0.86 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 1.868 (ton-hours)
*For Vehicle Type Eta, Segment 1 consumes 0.382 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 0.642 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 0.277 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 1.749 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 1.43 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 1.261 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 1.038 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 0.668 (ton-hours)
*For Vehicle Type Theta, Segment 1 consumes 1.255 (ton-hours), Segment 2 consumes 1.465 (ton-hours), Segment 3 consumes 1.627 (ton-hours), Segment 4 consumes 0.492 (ton-hours), Segment 5 consumes 1.326 (ton-hours), Segment 6 consumes 1.422 (ton-hours), Segment 7 consumes 1.246 (ton-hours), Segment 8 consumes 1.51 (ton-hours)

The cumulative transit time allocated to each route segment is strictly limited by its operational window:
* Segment 1's total transit time must not exceed 118.808 hours
* Segment 2's total transit time must not exceed 138.991 hours
* Segment 3's total transit time must not exceed 211.924 hours
* Segment 4's total transit time must not exceed 207.322 hours
* Segment 5's total transit time must not exceed 207.878 hours
* Segment 6's total transit time must not exceed 105.31 hours
* Segment 7's total transit time must not exceed 174.701 hours
* Segment 8's total transit time must not exceed 155.468 hours

Under the imperative condition that for every segment—Segment 1 through Segment 8—the aggregate transit time must remain within its prescribed limit, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each vehicle type in order to maximize the firm's total revenue.
